title: Exit discharge.
officialText:
Exits are permitted to discharge into a fenced or walled courtyard. Enclosed yards or courts shall be of a size to
accommodate all occupants, a minimum of 50 feet (15 240 mm) from the building with a net area of 15 square feet (1.4 m2) per person.
